attacks.claim: The one-click unpublish control is a non-focusable <span> with only an onClick handler and an aria-hidden icon. Keyboard-only and screen-reader editors cannot reach or identify it, which fails WCAG 2.1.1 (Keyboard) and 4.1.2 (Name, Role, Value), and the release requires AA conformance.
attacks.evidence: . ABSENT: a button element or role="button", tabIndex, keyboard handler, or aria-label on the control.
